design.calibration: Second-highest fine response maximum across six development ordinary photo groups, floored at .25.
design.method: Learn the normal phase in two spatial folds on 32 px cells. If the coarse rule has no region, search 16 px cells at half-cell spacing. Require one alternate phase with closure >= .62 and at least .25 above the reference in at least two-thirds of the 2x2, 2x3, 3x2 or 3x3 cells.
design.outcomes: A camera interpolation change is a local editing cue with zero AI-origin confidence.
design.scope: 2048 by 1536 bare opaque 16-bit PNG, developed on the native sensor grid.
design.useful: Minimum changed-pixel recall .50 and intersection over union .30.
